subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should OpenClaw extend Feishu group chat from sender/topic-scoped sessions into automatic per-sender subagent lifecycle management?
rationale: The request crosses routing, memory isolation, per-user skills/config, authorization, lifecycle cleanup, and quota/cost policy, so the permanent behavior needs maintainer intent before code work.

options.title: Design default-off Feishu group subagents
options.body: Approve a bounded Feishu-plugin design with explicit opt-in, lifecycle cleanup, security boundaries, and validation before implementation.

options.title: Keep current session-scoping model
options.body: Treat groupSessionScope plus manual/thread-bound subagent flows as the supported path and document that automatic group subagents are out of scope for now.

options.title: Prototype outside core first
options.body: Ask interested teams to prove the orchestration as a separate plugin or ClawHub package until a missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Design default-off Feishu group subagents
recommendation.body: Approve a bounded Feishu-plugin design with explicit opt-in, lifecycle cleanup, security boundaries, and validation before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a Feishu plugin product/security decision and the issue timeline repeatedly routes the Feishu cluster to this handle.
